description: Issue a certificate recording the fact of an agreement only. AstraNL holds no money, guarantees no performance and is not a party. Submit only an agreement the parties have actually made and authorized you to record. A step can stand on confirmed references supplied in based_on. The connector sets created_by; it is not a caller field. The JSON request must be at most 25000 bytes. One party may record what was agreed and let the other confirm. The first response returns confirm_url with confirmation_capability once; keep it and give it to the other party only. They confirm or dispute on that page, or their agent calls commitment_confirm. Until answered or the 30-day offer expires, commitment_verify shows PENDING. Put price, date and extent of work as plain text in obligations or conditions. context is optional free metadata; context.data_quality set to test marks a rehearsal, excluded from real counts. Whoever holds the id or link can read the record.
name: commitment_attest
